name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the polaris docker product (composes an app named rcore)

modules.name: base
modules._comment: Required by polaris: corporate/polaris/frappe's Loan and LoanTransfer doctypes have Link fields with options="Branch", and Branch is only defined in this module. Without composing it, polaris's doctype links would fail to resolve.

modules.name: polaris
modules._comment: crm is a hard requirement alongside polaris: polaris's loan_application reads CRM Lead.kyc_status, so this template must always compose the crm module too.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, deals, contacts, organizations, notes, tasks, call logs, statuses) ported from Frappenize/crm (frappe/crm fork) into the productivity SDK. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone frappe/crm app — a site must NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names (CRM Lead, CRM Deal, ...) are intentionally identical and would double-define. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.
